## Change / 改动

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.
说明解决的问题和改动后的行为。

## Verification / 验证

Record relevant checks and their results. Distinguish UI verification from automated tests.
记录必要验证及结果，区分真实界面验证与自动测试。

## Limits / 限制

Note any remaining limitations. Do not include private clipboard data or credentials.
说明仍存在的限制，请勿包含私人剪贴板数据或密钥。
